serviceDescription.title: 2. Description of Service
serviceDescription.content: Hospeda is an online platform that connects guests with hosts offering short-term accommodations. We facilitate bookings but do not own or operate the accommodations listed on our platform.

accountRegistration.body: To access certain features, you will need to create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials and all activities performed under your account. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.

conditions.cancellation: You are subject to the host's cancellation policies
conditions.rules: You must comply with the accommodation's house rules

userResponsibilities.body: You agree to use our services in a responsible and legal manner. Using the platform for illegal, fraudulent, or rights-infringing activities is prohibited. We reserve the right to suspend or cancel accounts that violate these rules.

cancellationPolicies.title: 6. Cancellation Policies
cancellationPolicies.content: Cancellation policies vary by host and are clearly displayed during the booking process. Hospeda may charge non-refundable service fees as specified at the time of booking.

liabilityLimitation.content: Hospeda acts as an intermediary between guests and hosts. We are not responsible for the quality, safety, or legality of listed accommodations, the accuracy of descriptions, or the ability of users to complete transactions.

termsModifications.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes take effect immediately upon publication on the website. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the modified terms.

termination.content: We may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these terms or for any other reason, at our sole discretion, with or without prior notice.

applicableLaw.content: These terms are governed by the laws of the country where Hospeda has its principal place of business, without regard to conflict of law principles.

page.title: Terms and Conditions
page.description: Terms and conditions of use for the Hospeda platform

aceptacion.title: 1. Acceptance of the terms
aceptacion.body: By accessing and using the Hospeda platform (the Service), you agree to these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to any part of these terms, you may not access the Service.

uso-servicio.title: 2. Use of the service
uso-servicio.body: The Service helps travelers discover accommodations, food and drink venues, experiences and other tourism resources and contact providers. You agree to use the Service only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these Terms. If you use the AI tools, verify details affecting your trip, such as prices and availability, with the provider.

registro.title: 3. Account registration
registro.body: To use certain features of the Service, you must create an account with accurate, complete and current information. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity under your account.

publicacion.title: 4. Publishing listings
publicacion.body: Providers who list accommodations, food and drink venues or experiences guarantee that the information they provide is truthful, accurate and complete. Hospeda reserves the right to review, modify or remove listings that do not meet our policies.

reservas.title: 5. Reservations and payments
reservas.body: Reservations and their payments are arranged directly between the traveler and the provider. Hospeda facilitates contact and does not process reservation payments. Hospeda subscription payments are processed through Mercado Pago. Plan terms are shown before purchase.

cancelaciones.title: 6. Cancellations and refunds
cancelaciones.body: Reservation cancellation and refund terms depend on the provider and what was agreed at booking. To cancel a Hospeda subscription, use the subscriptions section of your account. Article 10 links to the channel for exercising the right of withdrawal.

propiedad-intelectual.title: 7. Intellectual property
propiedad-intelectual.body: All platform content, including text, images, logos, designs and software, is owned by Hospeda or its respective owners. Reproduction without express permission is prohibited.

limitacion.title: 8. Limitation of liability
limitacion.body: Hospeda does not guarantee uninterrupted availability of the Service or the accuracy of information provided by third parties. Under no circumstances are we liable for indirect, incidental or consequential damages.

modificaciones.title: 9. Changes
modificaciones.body: We reserve the right to change these Terms at any time. Changes take effect when published on the platform. Continued use of the Service constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

contacto.title: 10. Contact
contacto.body: If you have questions about these Terms and Conditions, contact us at info@hospeda.com.ar or through our contact form.

withdrawal.title: Right of withdrawal
withdrawal.description: How to withdraw from a Hospeda subscription within 10 calendar days of the charge.
withdrawal.intro: If you bought a Hospeda subscription, you can withdraw from it within 10 calendar days of the day of the charge you want to revoke (Resolution 424/2020, Argentina).
withdrawal.effects: Once we record your request, the subscription is cancelled, the service ends at that moment and we request a refund of that charge in full.
withdrawal.howTo: Send us your request through the contact form: you do not need to sign in. Include the email of your Hospeda account.
withdrawal.mailAlternative: You can also write to us at {{email}}.
